title: Alli Rae Design & Build: the firm's real site on the Designer theme, and a script that creates its Space
detail: Follows LIVE-1490 and LIVE-1491. lib/sites/alli-rae-site.ts holds the firm's own words as Designer blocks (home, portfolio, about, three project pages, Ready to Build Meeting, Schedule Consultation) with its photos in public/sites/alli-rae, four typos fixed. scripts/seed-alli-rae.mts prints one guarded SQL transaction that adds the Space alli-rae (Business plan, comped, owned by the owner's profile, claim token minted) and publishes the site through save_website_editor, the function the editor's Publish button calls. Not run by the PR: the owner pastes the SQL after the Designer theme is live. The Space is handed to Alli with /spaces/claim/<token>.
